## Background

The variant [rs12913832](https://www.snpedia.com/index.php/Rs12913832) is strongly associated with eye color. Persons with the AA or AG genotypes most likely have brown eyes, while persons with the GG genotypes most likely have blue eyes.   


## Goal

In this exercise the goal is to calculate the allele frequency of the rs12913832 variant from a VCF file, and plot the frequency of the different genotypes.

## Required materials

[Download a subset](https://nextcloud.dc.scilifelab.se/s/NbbymL3w8BPS2x7/download) of the 1000Genomes data, container 40 samples with variants on chromosome 15. For more information about the VCF format, see [here](https://samtools.github.io/hts-specs/VCFv4.3.pdf).

## Instructions

The rs12913832 SNP is located on chromosome 15, position 28365618 (genome build hg19). The VCF file you have downloaded contains a subset of variants on chromosome 15, that have been called using hg19.

### Get the allele counts

Read the VCF file (make sure to read the VCF specifications to understand where the information you want is located), and extract the sample counts for each genotype; AA, AG, GG. How many persons are likely blue-eyed?

### Plot the frequencies

Plot a bar plot with the frequencies of each genotype.
